slice.other_bits: all zero in parents; offspring mutations remain enabled
slice.therapy: externally fixed alpha=0 or alpha=1; no threshold switching inside panels

scope: Exact one-step projected conditional drift on a specified full-genotype-state slice; not an exact autonomous reduction of the evolving tumor

arrow_length.linear: Euclidean raw-count drift / 10000 / 16, equal axis units
arrow_length.log: Euclidean phi(raw-count mean)-phi(current) displacement / 6, equal axis units
arrow_length.normalization: one common scalar per figure; no per-vector normalization or panel autoscaling
arrow_length.zero: origin has zero drift, shown as a point instead of a finite arrow

verification: every grid point checked against projected_offspring_mean of its explicit full population; total conservation and shared scales checked
interpretation: discrete-generation expected increments, not continuous-time derivatives
logarithmic arrow lengths are not absolute-cell increments
other mutations can move future full states off this slice
